task: Add backend MCP config clone capability with 'Copy N of X' naming, credential stripping, admin-only permission and an independent copy.

key_reasoning.reason: Closest pattern is MCPConfigService.create plus the client-driven Assistant clone (source_assistant_id). Neither covers server-side copy naming or credential stripping, so the security-sensitive gap is a divergence. Secrets sit in auth_token, free-form headers/env and the encrypted auth_config.client_secret. The unique partial index on auth_config.id would return 409 on a verbatim copy. The acceptance criteria list specific error and collision cases, and no existing test template covers them (no router tests, no naming-collision tests). Name-collision numbering is also race-prone, and a 'Copy N of ' prefix can exceed the 255-char name limit.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk raised to L: the closest existing pattern does not cover credential stripping (security-sensitive), and the enumerated edge cases have no test template
